'''Krillis''' was a corpulent [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the resurgent [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], he was assigned by [[Darth Zash|Lord Zash]] to oversee her new [[Darth Nox|apprentice]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Before its removal from the game, Lord Krillis introduced the mission "Advanced Training: Sith Inquisitor" for Sith Inquisitor players who had just completed the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. He could be found both on [[Vaiken Spacedock]] and in the [[Sith Sanctum]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], where he directed players to their Advanced Class trainer, [[Overseer (Sith)|Overseer]] [[Kryos]].<ref name="TOR" />
